question: Which of the following states had the highest percentage of Scheduled Tribes in the country as per census 2011?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Madhya Pradesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Scheduled Tribes** are** indigenous people** who are recognized by the Indian government as belonging to specific ethnic and cultural groups.
 
• They are entitled to** certain benefits and protections** under the Indian Constitution and various government schemes.
 
• According to the **census of 2011**, **Madhya Pradesh** had the highest percentage of Scheduled Tribes in the country with** 21.1% of the total population**.
 
• **Rajasthan** had a Scheduled Tribe population of **13.5%**, which was **lower **than that of Madhya Pradesh.
 
• **Maharashtra** had a Scheduled Tribe population of **10.1%**, which was even lower than Rajasthan and Madhya Pradesh.
